_source: Extracted from the practice theme at /tmp/burns-zip/JeffreyBurns/_css/theme.css (authoritative named palette: .c-blue #74bdc2, .c-gray #3e3e3e, .c-default #979797, .c-white #fff, .c-black #000; fonts .ff-default Montserrat, .ff-Amiri Amiri) and reconciled against the harness-green reference page implant-tooth.html for the full working palette (caresmiles.com feel). Practice theme.css only names 5 colors; the extended teal/dark/tan hexes below come from the proven reference page, not the practice theme.
_rules: Light theme always. White/off-white/light-grey base + teal #74bdc2 accent + #3e3e3e deepest text neutral. No pure #000 on text, nav, or headings (media wells only). No em dashes, no AI buzzwords. Never the word 'specialist' (use 'Meet the Doctor'). Never change a slug (keep trailing slash). DreamSmile branding + logo ONLY on pages the PAGE-TEMPLATE-MAP flags DreamSmile = Yes. Real practice assets only, no stock/AI faces.

hexRoles.#b0e0e9: pale teal borders + dark-section accent numerals --pale2
hexRoles.#74bdc2: brand teal accent, nav CTA button --teal-brand
hexRoles.#3e3e3e: deepest text neutral / graphite body default (brief spec) --graphite
hexRoles.#c6b48d: tan / gold secondary CTA + warranty accent --tan
hexRoles.#000000: MEDIA WELLS ONLY (before/after cards, testimonial cards, video posters). Never on text, nav, or page background.

fonts.heading: 'Amiri', Georgia, serif
fonts._headingUsage: h1/h2 display = Amiri serif (italic accent word per Figma). h3/h4 subheads = Montserrat 800. Larger readable type for 55+ readers.

logo._note: jburns (logo.png) is the primary J. Burns practice mark, use site-wide. jburnsWhite (logo-white.png) is the reverse for dark backgrounds and footer. dreamsmile-logo.png is the DreamSmile program mark, use ONLY where PAGE-TEMPLATE-MAP flags DreamSmile = Yes. Use the real file at full resolution, never a screenshot or AI substitute.

trademark: DreamSmile is a trademark: render it 'DreamSmile™'. Keep the ™ small and superscript so it reads as a mark, not a headline element. Show DreamSmile branding only on implant / DreamSmile-flagged pages (per PAGE-TEMPLATE-MAP), never site-wide. If the ™ looks oversized or clunky at any size, shrink it; if it still looks bad, remove it and flag it. J. Burns practice logo carries no trademark symbol.

cta._phoneRule: Tel-linked (tel:540-740-8937) beside the primary CTA, above the fold, on every page.
